title: Memorandum On The Movements Of E.A. Sanegin, Soviet Employee

page_data.en:
Special Branch S.2.
November 6, 1932.

Memorandum on the movements of E.A. Sanegin,
Soviet Employee.

E.A. Sanegin, employee of the Centrosojus,
arrived in Shanghai from the USSR via Dairen on
October 9, 1932 by the s.s. "Hoten Maru," together
with his wife and a child.
He is a Soviet citizen, 42 years of age and
holds Soviet passport No. 8794 issued on August 18, 1932
at Moscow.
He is attached to the local branch of the
Centrosoju.
He is residing at No. 10 Hankow Road.

G Tcherensbansky
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch
Information.
J le
7/11/32
SBA 6///
